text: Transportation Services is requesting approval for the removal of the existing on-street accessible parking space on the east side of Heath Crescent, north of Heath Street East as it is no longer required. This has been confirmed by Transportation Services. The removal will aid in maximizing available on-street parking for other residents/motorists.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible parking space on the east side of Heath Crescent, between a point 9.2 metres north of Heath Street East and a point 5.5 metres further north.
